thesis: The page is the back of the machine: every section is an access panel held by four screws, and scrolling unscrews it so the cause behind the symptom is lit by the work light.

signature.name: Screw-Corner Access Panels
signature.summary: Numbered sheet-metal panels (PANEL 00-07) with four Phillips screw heads and a symptom | cause split; screws spin out as the section enters, the panel lifts and the behind-the-panel half is lit amber. Reused as hero, the 7-step service-call story, service cards, review panels (what they saw / what was behind it), price card, the 4-step form (each step drives a screw home) and the footer panel screwed shut.

palette.family: Enamel Black + Bare-Bulb Amber + Fuse Red

layoutMoves: every section is a two-cell panel: YOU NOTICE | BEHIND THE PANEL, split by a screwed seam column
pinned 7-panel service-call story that unscrews panel by panel
mono part-label rows for prices and reviews, screws in the corners

motion.intro: 4 hero screws spin out, the centre seam opens 12px, an amber work-light cone wipes onto the BLOWN fuse tag (<=1.1s, skippable)
stories: One service call: pinned 7 panels, each unscrews and lifts to reveal the cause (unscrew + lift)
Meter needle and vent-length bar draw to their value when the tools answer (draw)
motion.hover: screw turns 90deg + amber seam line grows scaleX from left, 200ms
